map.冷负荷 ≈ 围护传热 + 人员显热 + 设备散热 + 新风负荷（经验估算法）: Cooling load is approximately envelope heat transfer plus occupant sensible heat plus equipment heat plus fresh air load (empirical estimation method)
map.按房间面积、层高、朝向、人数、设备与照明功率，采用经验估算法汇总围护传热、人员、: Estimate total cooling load from envelope heat transfer, occupants, equipment and fresh air by room area, ceiling height, orientation, number of people, equipment and lighting power using an empirical estimation method, for air conditioner selection reference.
map.💡 围护结构负荷=面积×朝向系数(W/m²)；人员负荷=人数×130W；新风负荷: Envelope load = area times orientation factor (W/m2); occupant load = number of people times 130 W; fresh air load = volume times air change rate times 3.5
map.围护结构负荷含外墙传热与日射得热，朝向系数为综合简化值: The envelope load includes exterior wall heat transfer and solar heat gain; the orientation factor is a comprehensive simplified value
map.人员散热按静坐办公 130W/人（显热+潜热）计算: Occupant heat dissipation is calculated at 130 W/person (sensible plus latent) for seated office work
map.新风负荷按换气次数 1.5 次/h、焓差 3.5 kJ/m³ 估算: Fresh air load is estimated at 1.5 air changes per hour and enthalpy difference 3.5 kJ/m3
map.📚 深度解析：空调冷负荷计算（逐项负荷与匹数匹配）: In-depth: Air Conditioning Cooling Load Calculation (itemized load and tonnage matching)
map.家用/办公室选型：按面积、朝向、人数与发热设备算总冷负荷: Home / office selection: compute total cooling load by area, orientation, number of people and heat-generating equipment
map.匹数匹配：把总负荷折算成空调匹数，避免选大或选小: Tonnage matching: convert total load into air conditioner tonnage to avoid oversizing or undersizing
map.节能诊断：看清各项负荷占比，找主要热源: Energy diagnosis: see the proportion of each load and find the main heat source
map.算法：围护结构负荷 = 面积×朝向系数（北向 80、东/西向 120、南向 15: Algorithm: envelope load = area times orientation factor (north 80, east/west 120, south 150, southwest 200 W/m2); occupant load = number of people times 130 W; equipment load = equipment power times 0.8 (simultaneous use factor); lighting load = lighting power times 0.9 (ballast factor);
map.= 面积×层高×1.5×3.5/3.6（换气 1.5 次/h、焓差 3.5kJ/: = area times ceiling height times 1.5 times 3.5 / 3.6 (1.5 air changes per hour, enthalpy difference 3.5 kJ/m3); total load is the sum of five items; load per area = total load / area; tonnage = total load (kW) / 2.5; less than 1.5 ton choose 1 ton wall unit, less than 3 ton choose 1.5 to 2 ton, less than 6 ton choose 3 to 5 ton cabinet / ceiling unit, otherwise central air conditioning / VRF is recommended.
map.例：50m²、层高 3m、南向、5 人、设备 1000W、照明 300W → 围: Example: 50 m2, ceiling height 3 m, south, 5 people, equipment 1000 W, lighting 300 W gives envelope 7500 W, occupants 650 W, equipment 800 W, lighting 270 W, fresh air 218.75 W, total 9438.75 W (9.44 kW), load per area 188.8 W/m2, requires 3.78 ton, recommend 3 to 5 ton cabinet / ceiling unit. If 20 m2, ceiling height 2.8 m, north, 2 people, equipment 300 W, lighting 120 W gives envelope 1600 W, occupants 260 W, equipment 240 W, lighting 108 W, fresh air 81.67 W, total 2289.67 W (2.29 kW), 114.5 W/m2, 0.92 ton, a 1 ton wall unit is enough.
map.住宅通常 80~120W/m²，办公室 120~180W/m²，设备密集或西晒房: Residential is usually 80 to 120 W/m2, office 120 to 180 W/m2, equipment-dense or west-exposed rooms can reach above 200 W/m2. This example is high due to 1000 W equipment and 5 dense occupants; reducing simultaneous equipment use or switching to north orientation can lower it significantly.
map.为什么新风负荷按换气次数算？: Why is fresh air load calculated by air change rate?
map.新风负荷 = 换气量×空气密度×焓差，工具简化为 体积×1.5 次/h×3.5k: Fresh air load = ventilation volume times air density times enthalpy difference; the tool simplifies it to volume times 1.5 per hour times 3.5 kJ/m3 divided by 3.6 to get watts; rooms with dense occupancy or poor air tightness should increase the air change rate.
